title: NAVAIR high energy electromagnetic field generator experiment

tellings.quote: We worked on a high energy electromagnetic field generated experiment uh at Navier. Uh however we weren't able to obtain a charge an electrical charge of more than 10 the minus 8 kms. We need at least one to show that the pis effect is correct.

plain: A Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais, who holds patents some call UFO patents, says he worked on an experiment at NAVAIR, the Navy's air systems command, that used a high-energy electromagnetic field generator. He says the team could only build up a tiny electric charge, far short of the amount needed to prove what he calls the Pais effect, his own proposed physical effect. If it had worked, he suggests, it would have shown his theory was correct.
